changelog:
Initial release of error-message-improver skill.

- Provides a structured workflow to improve the clarity and usefulness of error messages for users and support teams.
- Outputs practical templates, checklists, or workflows to explain what failed, why, and what to do next.
- Emphasizes actionable, locally feasible solutions and avoids reliance on cloud-only or large-scale AI.
- Validates results against clear success criteria and surfaces any remaining risks or required follow-up.
